approvedHook: Whisper got every word right. Why are the captions still late?
approvedCta: Check the timing on one spoken sentence.
narration: Whisper got every word right. Why are the captions still late?
Words and timing are separate checks. I am using one short recording with its actual saved recognition output.
The recognized sentence matches the approved text. That is one checked example, not a guarantee about every recording.
For this demonstration, I deliberately move the caption track one second later. Every word stays the same.
This is an imposed delay, not an error measured in the original Whisper run. The labels make that distinction visible.
The decoded comparison frame comes from the same audio with original and deliberately delayed caption tracks.
The timing table shows the shift. The original timestamps are recognition estimates, so they still need review against the audio.
A correct timing file also needs the correct placement in the video. Inspect the actual encoded output.
If the words are right, check the timeline before generating another voice recording. Review the opening, scene changes and ending.
